material_findings.finding: Command templates, intent regexes and agentic-router precedence drifted independently: commands could silently fall through to chat, deterministic file search could be hijacked by agentic routing, and an ostensibly routed file-search worker still crashed at subprocess invocation.
material_findings.current_transfer: ClayCode/H1 should define one typed command/intent contract with generated or validated surface templates, recognizer parity tests, deterministic precedence and executable handler receipts. UI registration alone is not capability evidence.

material_findings.finding: Voice/PTT initially used a separate mini-router and therefore had feature semantics different from typed input; later both paths converged on the same full command router.
material_findings.current_transfer: Dissolved multimodal FRANK should normalize modality-specific sensor input before a shared intent/effect semantic gateway; H1/H2 differential tests should demand equivalent state/effect outcomes for semantically identical typed/spoken commands unless modality itself is causally relevant.

material_findings.finding: Historical repository state tracked runtime/user databases, machine-specific config and hardcoded credential material before explicit untracking/environment-based corrections.
material_findings.current_transfer: UnifiedDB/runtime state must remain provenance-linked but physically separated from source-control artifacts; secrets never enter ClayGraph/research receipts/model context. Snapshot/recovery needs explicit data-class policy rather than git-as-state-store.

material_findings.finding: Hardcoded developer root paths and DISPLAY assumptions were widespread across services/scripts before environment/root-derived correction.
material_findings.current_transfer: H3 packaging/project-hardware acceptance requires path/display/resource identity to be runtime-resolved and replayable; no developer-machine constants may masquerade as semantic requirements.

material_findings.finding: A resize performance fix was followed by a cascade-loop regression, rollback and another strategy; event-loop/layout behavior formed a feedback system rather than a stateless rendering detail.
material_findings.current_transfer: Performance optimizations affecting event scheduling require measured before/after receipts and rollback tests. Harness UI/effect surfaces should include event-loop stability and user-intent preservation under reflow/streaming.

material_findings.finding: Entity agents originally failed immediately on transient connection errors and could notify successful completion despite missing summaries; later added bounded retries and suppressed false success notifications.
material_findings.current_transfer: No success claim without positive completion evidence; retry is explicit bounded state with attempt identity/backoff, and downstream notifications/memory commits must depend on terminal success state.

material_findings.finding: Bare exception handlers across many subsystems swallowed process-control exceptions such as shutdown/interrupt signals.
material_findings.current_transfer: Effect/recovery semantics must distinguish operational errors from cancellation/shutdown authority; broad catch-all behavior is a regression target.

negative_results: A command can exist in the palette yet be semantically dead because its expansion does not match the router grammar.
Broad agentic regexes can capture narrower deterministic intents unless precedence is explicit.
Successful intent recognition does not imply executable handler correctness.
Separate modality routers drift and create capability inequivalence.
Runtime/user databases in source control conflate code provenance with personal mutable state.
Hardcoded secrets and developer paths create security and portability failures.
Bare exception handling can suppress intended cancellation/shutdown semantics.
UI throttling intended as a performance fix can create event/layout feedback loops and require rollback.
Transient failures should not immediately collapse when bounded retry is safe, and missing terminal output must not be reported as completed.

branch_feedback.harness: DELTA: add registry↔router↔handler differential tests, intent-precedence adversarials, modality-parity traces, shutdown/cancellation tests, event-loop regression/rollback, secret/state-boundary and retry-truth tests.
branch_feedback.claycode: DELTA: command schemas should compile/validate templates, recognizers, typed params and handlers into one contract; cancellation/retry/terminal state belong in effect semantics.
branch_feedback.claygraph: DELTA: encode modality normalization, intent selection, handler/effect receipt and terminal outcome edges; capability/source versions remain provenance nodes without secret payloads.
branch_feedback.unifieddb: DELTA: separate mutable personal/runtime state from source-control/research artifacts while retaining versioned migration/snapshot links; secrets are excluded payload class.
branch_feedback.gwt: NO_CHANGE: this shard establishes routing/effect parity, not a new workspace-broadcast mechanism.
branch_feedback.hyperposition: NO_CHANGE: no new set-valued coupling result.
branch_feedback.emergenz: NO_CHANGE: no new emergence evidence; UI/runtime feedback loops are engineering dynamics only.
